description: This file contains the implementation of the ConsistentRingProvider class, which manages node membership and responsibilities in a consistent hashing ring for Orleans runtime. It includes methods for adding/removing servers, computing ranges, handling silo status notifications, and notifying range change subscribers.

classes.name: ConsistentRingProvider
classes.description: Manages a consistent hashing ring of silo nodes, handling membership, responsibilities, and range notifications in Orleans runtime.

methods.name: GetPrimaryTargetSilo
methods.description: Returns the primary silo responsible for a given key.

methods.name: GetMyRange
methods.description: Returns the range of responsibility assigned to this silo.

methods.name: SubscribeToRangeChangeEvents
methods.description: Subscribes an observer to range change notifications.

methods.name: UnSubscribeFromRangeChangeEvents
methods.description: Unsubscribes an observer from range change notifications.

methods.name: SiloStatusChangeNotification
methods.description: Handles notifications of silo status changes, updating membership and responsibilities accordingly.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Unsubscribes from silo status events, cleaning up resources.
